meta.title: BlueFairy Anti-Spam Demo
meta.author: Blue Fairy Development
meta.description: Demonstrates the BlueFairy Anti-Spam plugin with pre-seeded block log data.

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wpdb;
$table = $wpdb->prefix . 'bfas_log';
$traps = ['honeypot', 'timetrap', 'sfs'];
$forms = ['wp_comment', 'wp_register', 'wc_review', 'wc_register', 'wc_checkout'];
$ips   = ['192.168.1.100', '10.0.0.45', '203.0.113.55', '198.51.100.12', '172.16.0.9'];
for ($i = 0; $i < 20; $i++) {
    $days = rand(1, 60);
    $wpdb->insert($table, [
        'blocked_at'   => date('Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime("-{$days} days")),
        'trap'         => $traps[array_rand($traps)],
        'form'         => $forms[array_rand($forms)],
        'ip'           => $ips[array_rand($ips)],
        'email_hash'   => hash('sha256', 'demo' . $i . '@example.com'),
        'reported_sfs' => rand(0, 1),
    ]);
}
echo 'Seeded 20 demo log entries.';
